title: First full 60 s benchmark run — stabilize the committed gates
description: TASK-58's implementation (tuning passes, benchmark driver, bench script, CI test) is committed; the 60 s benchmark has never actually been run end-to-end. This task runs the full verification chain for the first time and fixes only the bugs the run surfaces. NO new tuning passes: no merged chunk meshes, no new rendering features — bug fixes in the driver/tally/monitor/script only.

steps.description: Full green after the render rewrites
steps.details: The suite was last green at 02:33 (start of the previous iteration) but the ship-mesh / remote-ships / ore-rocks / combat-fx / remote-entities rewrites (318c2b4) and the DOM-guard fix (8821a32) landed at 03:14. Run: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test (177 files, ~118 s). Fix any breakage the rewrites introduced — these are the only code changes this task allows besides step 2.

Runs 1 untuned baseline + 5 tuned 60 s runs (BENCH_DEFAULT_FRAMES = 3600 frames each, ~60 s wall per run, ~8-10 min total). Only the 10 s CI variant (600 frames, no-spike assertion) has ever run. Read the printed table (p50/p95/max/spikes/draws/mats/tris/fx/wall per run, p95 spread, DELTA block). Fix only bugs the run exposes in app/src/client/test/renderBenchmark.ts, app/scripts/bench-render.ts, or the tally/monitor code they exercise. Known candidates: (a) scene-graph tally counts vs the renderer.info stand-in semantics, (b) the no-spike or p95-variance gates tripping on headless Node GC pauses — note scripts/bench-transitions.ts uses NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc but bench:render does not; if GC is the cause, mirror that flag in package.json rather than changing the gate, (c) FrameMonitor maxFrameMs/frameSpikes accounting. Re-run after each fix; do not optimize the scene, do not add tuning passes.

The script must exit 0: zero frames > 50 ms in every tuned run (no-spike rule), draw calls < 120, materials < 40, triangles < 500 k in every tuned run, p95 spread across the 5 tuned runs < 20 % (AC-6). The absolute 16.7 ms median is NOT a failure gate on the dev machine (that is AC-2's stretch goal, handled with TASK-61 in the next task). The 10 s CI test (app/src/client/test/render-benchmark.test.ts) must stay green. .ralph/bench/TASK-58.json (written by the script with baseline + 5 tuned runs + p95 spread + delta) must exist and be committed — it is the record for TASK-61. Then a final npm run test + commit.

acceptanceCriteria: npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run test (177 files) all green
npm run bench:render exits 0: no tuned run has a frame > 50 ms; every tuned run < 120 draw calls, < 40 materials, < 500 k triangles; p95 spread across the 5 tuned runs < 20 %
.ralph/bench/TASK-58.json committed with real baseline + 5 tuned run numbers (this is the TASK-61 record)
The 10 s CI test (render-benchmark.test.ts) still passes
No new tuning passes implemented (no chunk-mesh merging, no new render features) — only bug fixes that make the committed benchmark runnable and its committed gates honest
notes:
Picks up where the last attempt (iteration 22, ran out of time at 03:21) stopped.

DONE (all committed — do not redo): bce401e: src/shared/perf.ts PERF_PROFILES table (high/medium/low, 'bench-run-1' placeholder comments), combat-fx FX caps + group expiry, profile-bridge, live label cap, FrameMonitor maxFrameMs/frameSpikes. 318c2b4: merged ships (ship-mesh.ts — 16 ships = 16 draws / 3 materials, legacy path behind merged: false), instanced ore (ore-rocks.ts — OreRockLayer instanced: true, <= 8 draws / 8 materials, legacy behind instanced: false), FX material pool + shared geometries (combat-fx.ts), benchmark driver (app/src/client/test/renderBenchmark.ts, 523 lines, DOM-free AC-1 scene: 16 ships in combat + 13-chunk streamed surface + 30 deposits + hazard discs + 4 drones + 20 labels + starfield), npm run bench:render (app/scripts/bench-render.ts — gates + variance check + writes .ralph/bench/TASK-58.json), 10 s CI test (app/src/client/test/render-benchmark.test.ts — PASSES in 1.2 s). 8821a32: document? guarded in CombatFx.stretched (Node ReferenceError).

Working tree: clean except .ralph/handoff/TASK-58.md (Ralph rewrites it; ignore/leave it).

Dead ends: document?. in Node code THROWS ReferenceError (fixed in 8821a32) — keep typeof guards in any bench-path code. Nothing else recorded.

Timing reference: full unit suite ~118 s (177 files / 1592 tests). CI bench test ~1.2 s (600 frames run in ~8x real time, so a 60 s run is ~60-75 s wall; 6 runs ~8-10 min total). The bench script wall-timeout per run is 180 s (wallTimeoutMs) — a run that exceeds it throws, which is itself a finding to fix.

Scope discipline: this task deliberately does NOT check the >= 30 % delta (the bench script prints it but does not fail on it) and does NOT rewrite the perf.ts comments — both belong to TASK-58.2, so a delta failure cannot drag implementation work into this iteration.
